title: Generation of pulsed and continuous-wave squeezed light with 87Rb vapor
claim: The scanned D2 conditions yielded excess noise without squeezing.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Preserve D-line-specific null tests.

title: Generation of pulsed and continuous-wave squeezed light with 87Rb vapor
claim: Residual 85Rb limits the high-detuning squeezing region.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Include measured isotope composition when comparing high-power data.

title: Polarization squeezing of light by single passage through an atomic vapor
claim: A tilted retarder selects generalized Stokes noise in a common optical path.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Map the UI phase to S2 cos(theta)+S3 sin(theta).

title: Polarization squeezing of light by single passage through an atomic vapor
claim: The minimum-noise phase differs among hyperfine transitions.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Compute squeezing-axis rotation instead of fixing it across detuning.

title: Quadrature noise in light propagating through a cold 87Rb atomic gas
claim: Phase-dependent noise is resolved, but sub-SQL squeezing is not established.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Use a null-result target rather than a positive cold-atom benchmark.

title: Quadrature noise in light propagating through a cold 87Rb atomic gas
claim: The numerical noise optimum occurs at finite population/coherence reset.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Test replenishment and decoherence jointly, not monotonic coherence-time improvement.

title: Polarization self-rotation in ultracold atomic 87Rb
claim: Residual magnetic fields break the opposite-ellipticity symmetry of cold-atom rotation.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Separate self-rotation from Faraday rotation in slope validation.

title: Polarization self-rotation in ultracold atomic 87Rb
claim: Cloud expansion and probe radiation pressure limit comparison with a static homogeneous model.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Do not infer cold-atom noise performance from rotation alone.

title: All-atomic source of squeezed vacuum with full pulse-shape control
claim: Longitudinal magnetic-field modulation controls noise-envelope shape without shifting its measured minimum phase.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ A future magnetic scan needs noise dynamics beyond a constant shear coefficient.

title: Quantum-enhanced magnetometer with low-frequency squeezing
claim: Residual laser intensity noise prevents truly shot-noise-limited detection below approximately 200 kHz.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Separate source covariance from detector and pump technical noise.

title: Quantum-enhanced magnetometer with low-frequency squeezing
claim: At high magnetometer density, squeezing advantage disappears and the squeezed probe can be noisier.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Propagate the quantum and technical noise through the sensing cell.

title: All-atomic generation and noise-quadrature filtering of squeezed vacuum in hot Rb vapor
claim: Asymmetric complex sideband transmission changes the optimum quadrature with analysis frequency.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Retain both sideband phases and absorption in a spectral noise model.

title: All-atomic generation and noise-quadrature filtering of squeezed vacuum in hot Rb vapor
claim: Passive filtering alone does not explain all observed excess noise.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Atomic and technical noise need separate treatment.

title: Effect of atomic noise on optical squeezing via polarization self-rotation in a thermal vapor cell
claim: Atomic excess noise prevents squeezing in the tested regimes despite strong classical self-rotation.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Do not validate noise predictions from a measured rotation slope alone.

title: Effect of atomic noise on optical squeezing via polarization self-rotation in a thermal vapor cell
claim: Four-level Langevin analysis contrasts cross-Kerr coupling with optical-pumping and emission noise.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Use this as a failure-case check for a microscopic noise extension.

title: Polarization squeezing in a four-level system
claim: Optical-pumping self-rotation adds low-frequency noise; crossed Kerr coupling enables higher-frequency vacuum squeezing.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Do not infer quantum-noise suppression from static rotation alone.

title: Polarization squeezing in a four-level system
claim: The calculation includes cavity feedback and polarization-switching thresholds.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Use as a mechanism reference, not a numerical benchmark for single-pass vapor.

title: Gaussian-beam-propagation theory for nonlinear optics involving an analytical treatment of orbital-angular-momentum transfer
claim: The Green-function mode expansion uses a first-order Born approximation and a weakly modified pump.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ A candidate spatial propagation layer must retain its perturbative limit.
locator: PDF p. 2, Sec. II.A, Eqs. (2)-(3); p. 7, conclusion

title: Gaussian-beam-propagation theory for nonlinear optics involving an analytical treatment of orbital-angular-momentum transfer
claim: The developed propagation treatment is classical and uses an idealized lossless, dispersionless medium.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Do not use this alone as a Langevin covariance or strong-absorption model.

title: Numerical investigation of the quantum fluctuations of optical fields transmitted through an atomic medium
claim: Two-polarization propagation includes Zeeman-resolved atomic Langevin diffusion and field spectra.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Reuse atomic operators while deriving a consistent frequency-dependent diffusion matrix.
locator: PDF pp. 3-5, Sec. II, Eqs. (1)-(20); Appendix

title: Numerical investigation of the quantum fluctuations of optical fields transmitted through an atomic medium
claim: Velocity classes enter both response and noise propagation.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Average the response and noise kernels before propagation; do not average squeezing in dB.

title: Numerical investigation of the quantum fluctuations of optical fields transmitted through an atomic medium
claim: Mean-field depletion is neglected despite propagation of quantum fluctuations.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Add pump evolution separately when extending to appreciable absorption.
locator: PDF p. 4, Sec. II, paragraph after Eqs. (5)-(6)

title: Improving sensitivity of an amplitude-modulated magneto-optical atomic magnetometer using squeezed light
claim: Resonant sensor absorption attenuates squeezing; technical noise dominates low-frequency lock-in readout.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Include sensing-cell loss and measurement-band filtering.

title: Improving sensitivity of an amplitude-modulated magneto-optical atomic magnetometer using squeezed light
claim: Higher sensor temperature increases excess noise and eventually removes squeezing.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Do not equate stronger magnetic response with better noise sensitivity.

title: Role of seeding in the generation of polarization squeezed light by an atomic Kerr medium
claim: Controlled orthogonal seeding improves measured compression, followed by saturation absent from the simple Kerr model.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Benchmark seeded data separately from vacuum-input PSR; seed necessity is model-specific.

title: Vacuum squeezing in atomic media via self-rotation
claim: Small-ellipticity rotation produces a phase-dependent vacuum variance through gL.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Retain the ellipticity and quadrature convention with the shear coefficient.

title: Vacuum squeezing in atomic media via self-rotation
claim: The optimized Rb estimate uses large gL, small absorption and separately treated ground hyperfine manifolds.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Do not treat the optimized prediction as measured data or as a finite-frequency atomic-noise calculation.

title: Low-frequency vacuum squeezing via polarization self-rotation in Rb vapor
claim: Squeezing extends into low sideband frequencies with a Ne-buffered cell.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Treat buffer-gas and frequency dependence as explicit model inputs.

title: Vacuum squeezing via polarization self-rotation and excess noise in hot Rb vapors
claim: Squeezing occupies a small region in density and power; excess noise dominates outside it.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Use null-squeezing regions as constraints, alongside extrema.

title: Vacuum squeezing via polarization self-rotation and excess noise in hot Rb vapors
claim: Including both excited hyperfine levels changes the predicted squeezing qualitatively.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Keep off-resonant excited levels in response and Langevin calculations.
locator: PDF p. 4, Fig. 4 and Numerical simulations

title: Vacuum squeezing via polarization self-rotation and excess noise in hot Rb vapors
claim: Far-detuned velocity groups substantially affect low-frequency noise.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Check velocity convergence for noise independently of classical rotation.
locator: PDF pp. 4-5, Fig. 5 and Doppler discussion

title: Vacuum-squeezing-enhanced micrometer-scale vapor-cell magnetometer
claim: Published measured/corrected squeezing is 4/4.5 dB; earlier preprint body gives 3/3.5 dB.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Use final values and preserve the distinct source versions.
locator: Published PDF p.3, Sec.III.A; preprint PDF p.4

title: Vacuum-squeezing-enhanced micrometer-scale vapor-cell magnetometer
claim: The 75 mm PSR source and approximately 100 um sensor have different temperatures and buffer-gas conditions.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Keep generation and sensing propagation as separate stages.

title: Excess optical quantum noise in atomic sensors
claim: Off-resonant coupling alters polarization noise even when its mean rotation contribution is negligible.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Fit or validate mean signal and covariance as distinct observables.

title: Excess optical quantum noise in atomic sensors
claim: Rotating detection toward the squeezed quadrature reduces the magnetometric response as well.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Optimize signal-to-noise, rather than squeezing alone, for a future sensor mode.

title: Experimental vacuum squeezing in rubidium vapor via self-rotation
claim: Noise exceeds a minimum-uncertainty description; absorption alone cannot explain the excess.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Include atomic excess noise separately from detector loss.

title: Experimental vacuum squeezing in rubidium vapor via self-rotation
claim: Best noise suppression occurs around 5-10 MHz; lower-frequency fluorescence degrades it.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Add analysis frequency before comparing a phase-only model to this measurement.

title: Self-rotation of resonant elliptically polarized light in collision-free rubidium vapor
claim: Doppler broadening suppresses isolated-transition effects, allowing multiple-transition mechanisms to dominate.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Retain excited hyperfine manifolds when validating the reused classical response.

title: Self-rotation of resonant elliptically polarized light in collision-free rubidium vapor
claim: Significant absorption is handled by integrating intensity, rotation and ellipticity through thin slices.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ An incremental extension can reuse the atomic solve along a longitudinal intensity trajectory.

title: Propagation of a squeezed optical field in a medium with superluminal group velocity
claim: Increasing atomic density advances the noise modulation while reducing squeezing through loss.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Couple temporal response and noise degradation; this is not superluminal information transfer.

title: Experimental characterization of the Gaussian state of squeezed light obtained via single passage through an atomic vapor
claim: Four Stokes variance measurements reconstruct the covariance and its principal axes.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Use the measured Stokes normalization and covariance rotation as validation targets.

title: Experimental characterization of the Gaussian state of squeezed light obtained via single passage through an atomic vapor
claim: Gaussian statistics receive empirical support in the measured band, not universal proof.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ State the frequency band when applying a Gaussian approximation.

title: Experimental characterization of the Gaussian state of squeezed light obtained via single passage through an atomic vapor
claim: Splitting the PSR output permits covariance-based entanglement and discord characterization.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Retain cross-covariances for future two-output calculations.

title: Large-scale array of squeezed light and synchronization using atomic vapor
claim: Moving atoms share ground-state coherence between channels in a paraffin-coated cell.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Model inter-beam transport and wall memory before applying this array result.

title: Large-scale array of squeezed light and synchronization using atomic vapor
claim: Squeezing-level synchronization is measured; direct dynamic phase-locking evidence is not established.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Keep phase locking and shared noise extrema separate in validation claims.

title: Generating squeezed vacuum field with nonzero orbital angular momentum with atomic ensembles
claim: OAM-matched local oscillator detects comparable squeezing at different power/density optima.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Track pump profile and detection-mode overlap.

title: Generating squeezed vacuum field with nonzero orbital angular momentum with atomic ensembles
claim: Beam expansion alone did not explain squeezing deterioration; differential mode mismatch remained unresolved.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Do not replace spatial dynamics with a beam-size loss rule.

title: Spatial multimode structure of atom-generated squeezed light
claim: Spatial masks produce noise incompatible with uniform single-mode attenuation.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Use modal covariance and local-oscillator projection for aperture changes.

title: Spatial multimode structure of atom-generated squeezed light
claim: Different Gouy phases and squeezing angles can reduce the detected modal sum.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Preserve phase and spatial geometry in propagation.

title: Spatial multimode structure of atom-generated squeezed light
claim: Illustrative modal squeezing is rescaled to measured suppression and omits atomic excess noise.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Do not treat the illustrative 11 dB fundamental mode as a measured result.

title: Multipass configuration for improved squeezed vacuum generation in hot Rb vapor
claim: Equal nominal optical depth does not make increased density and increased path length equivalent.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Keep density and geometry independent.

title: Multipass configuration for improved squeezed vacuum generation in hot Rb vapor
claim: Filtering first-cell squeezing while retaining its modified pump can improve second-cell output.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Model pump spatial preparation separately from inherited covariance.

title: Ultra-stable and high-performance squeezed vacuum source enabled via artificial intelligence control
claim: Measured squeezing depends nonmonotonically on temperature and transverse field, with power-dependent frequency shifts.
model_implication: ⟦AI⟧ Validate coupled control responses before using an empirical optimizer as a physics model.
